title: “Not Just News — These Are Lives”
paragraphs: Friends, today we see the world hurting — reports from Iran tell of thousands killed in a brutal crackdown, while global leaders talk peace and power. My heart breaks seeing so much suffering. God calls us not to numbness but to compassion (Psalm 34:18) and justice for the oppressed (Isaiah 1:17). Let’s pray for peace that heals, not just headlines. Pray with me for families caught in violence and for courage to stand for life and truth.
Matthew 5:9 — Blessed are the peacemakers. We pray and pursue peace.
